question.text: A solution of m-chloroaniline, m-chlorophenol and m-chlorobenzoic acid in ethyl acetate was extracted initially with a saturated solution of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mtext>C</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>O</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> to give fraction <math> <mrow> <mtext>A</mtext><mtext>.</mtext></mrow> </math> The left over organic phase was extracted with dilute <math> <mrow> <mtext>NaOH</mtext></mrow> </math> solution to give fraction <math> <mrow> <mtext>B</mtext><mtext>.</mtext></mrow> </math> The final organic layer was labelled as fraction <math> <mrow> <mtext>C</mtext><mtext>.</mtext></mrow> </math> Fraction <math> <mrow> <mtext>A,</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>B</mtext></mrow> </math> and <math> <mrow> <mtext>C,</mtext></mrow> </math> contain respectively.

solution.text: Fraction A, B and C, contain m-chlorobenzoic acid, m-chlorophenol and m-chloroaniline respectively
